verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe 'Browse with Copilot', where Copilot acts directly in Microsoft Edge by clicking, typing and navigating tabs. Users watch each step in real time and can take control at any time, and Copilot asks for supervision before sensitive actions such as purchases, bookings or sending emails. This directly matches operating a browser to complete tasks on websites. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that browser actions work reliably, and detail beyond Edge on how task research and completion perform across sites.
